description: Report one monitor's uptime percentage, average response time and incident count over the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days at once, to answer how reliable it has been. For a day-by-day series use get_uptime_daily; for response time per region use get_response_time_by_region; for the individual failures use list_check_results. Returns monitor_id and windows keyed 24h, 7d and 30d, each with uptime_percentage, downtime_seconds, observed_seconds, window_start (later than the window's start when the monitor is younger), total_checks, up_checks, down_checks, degraded_checks, incident_count and avg_response_time_ms. uptime_percentage is the share of observed time outside confirmed outages (an outage counts from the first failing probe to the first probe that is not DOWN; a failure only one region saw does not count; maintenance counts as up; hours with no checks are left out; null when nothing was observed). The check counts are informational: a failed check outside a confirmed outage does not lower uptime_percentage.

monitor_id.description: The monitor's uuid from list_monitors. An id that is not a monitor of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

name: get_uptime_summary

downtime_seconds.description: Seconds of confirmed downtime inside the window.

observed_seconds.description: Seconds inside the window the monitor was observed; uptime is measured over this time. Never less than downtime_seconds.

window_start.description: Start of the window: the window length before now, or when the monitor was created if that is later.

title: Get uptime for a monitor
